title: Monomial quotient first Tor with the specified chart coefficients
statement: Let $P$ be a commutative monoid, written multiplicatively, $A$ a commutative ring, $a:P\to(A,\cdot)$ a monoid homomorphism, and $H\subseteq P$ any subset. Set $R=\mathbf Z[P]=\bigoplus_{p\in P}\mathbf Zz^p$ with $z^pz^q=z^{pq}$, and define $I_H=(z^h\mid h\in H)\subseteq R$. Define the coefficient $R$-module $A_a$ by restriction of scalars along the ring homomorphism $R\to A$ taking $z^p$ to $a(p)$ and each integer to its canonical image in $A$. Define $T(a,H)=\operatorname{Tor}^R_1(R/I_H,A_a)$, with Tor derived in the first argument as in [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. The constructions include $I_H$ and $A_a$ themselves. If $HP\subseteq H$, then $I_H=\mathbf Z[H]=\bigoplus_{h\in H}\mathbf Zz^h$; empty and total subsets are allowed. No fs, sharpness, local-ring or log-structure hypothesis is imposed.
